# Blueprint

> Blueprint helps site owners decide which robotics candidate deserves a physical pilot.

A Task Evaluation Run is a paid engagement scoped to one workcell, a real task, two compatible candidates, and a pilot window. Blueprint captures the task, compares evidence, and returns a recommendation and physical test plan—or a reason to pause. Physical outcomes check the prediction; simulation is not a deployment guarantee.

Robot-team participation depends on task fit and site approval. Scope and pricing are agreed before evaluation begins. Contact: hello@tryblueprint.io.
